;Arts and culture
*[[Synod of Bishops for the Pan-Amazon region|Pan-Amazon region synod]]:
**[[Pope Francis]] visits [[Peru]] and meets 4,000 members of the [[Indigenous peoples|indigenous communities]] from the [[Amazon rainforest]]. He states that the people of the Amazon are threatened now more than ever, and questions the conservationist policies that affect the Peruvian rainforest. In [[Puerto Maldonado]], he asks for the indigenous communities to be recognized as partners instead of as minorities. He calls on the Peruvian people to put an end to practices that degrade women, and criticizes the [[Sterilization (medicine)|sterilization]] of indigenous women. [http://aa.com.tr/en/americas/pope-francis-visit-to-chile-and-peru-comes-to-an-end/1038139 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://www.americamagazine.org/faith/2018/01/19/peru-pope-francis-says-church-stands-peoples-amazon-and-earth (America)]
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Turkish military intervention in Afrin]]
**With a cross-border artillery bombardment into the [[Afrin Canton]], [[Turkey]] starts its announced military campaign to "destroy" the [[Kurds in Syria|Syrian Kurdish]] [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] group. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-turkey/turkey-shells-syrias-afrin-region-minister-says-operation-has-begun-idUKKBN1F80XH (Reuters)] 

;Business and economy
*[[Protests against Rodrigo Duterte]]
**Journalists in the [[Philippines]] protest the government's decision to cancel the license of [[Rappler]]. [http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2018/01/19/1779322/palace-black-friday-protest-shows-freedom-democracy-alive (''The Philippine Star'')], [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/rappler-philippine-duterte-move-to-close-news-website-9877794 (Channel News Asia)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Fifteen people are injured and an infant is killed after a car hits a group of pedestrians near [[Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro|Copacabana Beach]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]]. The police report that the driver had an [[epileptic seizure]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42742877 (BBC)]
*The bodies of ten [[Syria]]n men are found after a snowstorm on the [[Lebanon–Syria border]]. The [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese Army]] says they tried to enter Lebanon illegally. Two presumed [[People smuggling|people smugglers]] are arrested. [https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2018/Jan-19/434462-6-bodies-found-on-lebanon-syria-smuggling-route.ashx (''Daily Star'')] 

;Law and crime
*[[Sudan]]'s [[National Intelligence and Security Service (Sudan)|National Intelligence and Security Service]] arrests 7 journalists who were [[Freedom of the press|covering]] this week's economic protests in [[Khartoum]]. The charges are unclear. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/19/world/africa/sudan-journalists-arrests.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Outside the [[Fleury-Mérogis Prison|Fleury-Mérogis prison]], [[Law enforcement in France|French police]] clash with [[Prison officer|prison guards]] who are striking over the detention conditions in French jails. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-security-prison/french-police-clash-with-prison-guards-in-protest-over-jail-conditions-idUSKBN1F81W7 (Reuters)] 

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of China]]
**Citing a national "fervor", the [[Communist Party of China]] proposes writing the [[Xi Jinping Thought]] into the [[Constitution of the People's Republic of China|state constitution]], after it was already added to the [[Constitution of the Communist Party of China|party constitution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-politics/china-to-enshrine-xis-thought-into-state-constitution-amid-national-fervor-idUSKBN1F812P (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of the United States]]
**Presenting a new [[National Military Strategy (United States)|national defense strategy]], the [[United States Secretary of Defense]], [[Jim Mattis]], says [[terrorism]] is no longer the focus of the [[national security of the United States]]. Now it is [[competition]] between [[List of modern great powers|great powers]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42752298 (BBC)]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**A spokesperson for [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] says the government has seen no plans for [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|Foreign Secretary]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s idea of building a road bridge across the [[English Channel]] between [[France]] and the United Kingdom. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/19/boris-johnson-wants-to-build-a-bridge-to-france.html (CNBC)]
*[[Political appointments of the first Trump administration|Political appointments by Donald Trump]]
**[[Carl Higbie]],  [[Corporation for National and Community Service]] Chief of External Affairs, apologizes and resigns from his position with the agency that runs [[AmeriCorps]] after racist and anti-Muslim remarks he made in 2013 are reported by [[CNN]]. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/19/579111221/carl-higbie-resigns-from-trump-administration-after-bigoted-comments-surface (NPR)]

;Science and technology
*An [[Atlas V]] rocket successfully deployed the fourth [[Space-Based Infrared System|SBIRS]] satellite for the [[United States Air Force]]. This launch completes the [[geosynchronous orbit|geosynchronous]] segment of SBIRS and provides a global missile detection system for the United States. [http://spaceflight101.com/atlas-v-launches-fourth-sbirs-missile-warning-satellite/ (Spaceflight 101)]
*[[Twitter]] announces it is notifying  677,775 people in the U.S. that they had some contact with the  Kremlin-linked [[Internet troll|troll farm]], [[Internet Research Agency]], during the 2016 election period. The count of  [[Russia]]n-linked bot accounts is now 50,258, the company having identified an additional 13,512  bot accounts since its November Congressional briefing.  [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/19/twitter-users-russian-trolls-437247 (Politico)] [https://mumbrella.com.au/facebook-announces-plans-to-let-users-decide-publishers-trustworthiness-494813 (Mumbrella)]
